---
title: "System Design"
description: "Design reliable, scalable systems starting from concrete engineering requirements."
---

System design connects requirements, constraints, trade-offs, and failure scenarios. Start with a real application problem, examine the design decisions, and only then introduce the abstractions.

## Learning paths

- [Fundamentals](fundamentals.qmd) — Requirements, capacity estimates, latency, throughput, and service boundaries.
- [Distributed Systems](distributed-systems.qmd) — Multiple nodes, failures, replication, and partition tolerance.
- [Data Consistency](data-consistency.qmd) — What readers observe after concurrent writes, and why consistency guarantees matter.

## Planned topics

Caching, load balancing, message queues, database scaling, observability, fault tolerance, and architecture interviews.

The material will use consistent running examples rather than disconnected definitions.
